title: Functional Attentive Interpretable Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.05846v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In function-on-function regression, the coefficient surface $\beta(s,t)$ may exhibit complex support structure---from localized patches to global patterns such as disconnected regions, bands, or rings---where effect similarity does not align with Euclidean proximity. Projection-based methods that rely on fixed basis expansions can obscure such structure, while direct smoothing approaches risk oversmoothing the surface and its boundaries. We propose Functional Attentive Interpretable Regression (FAIR), which represents $\beta(s,t)$ directly through coordinate features and uses self-attention to learn effect-adaptive neighborhoods, enabling information sharing at both local and global scales. A scalar compression network maps these learned representations to the coefficient surface. translated_title: 函数型注意力可解释回归
translated_abstract: 在函数对函数回归中，系数面 β(s,t) 可能表现出复杂的支撑结构——从局部斑块到诸如不连通区域、带状或环状等全局模式——此时效应相似性与欧氏邻近性并不一致。依赖固定基展开的投影方法可能会掩盖这种结构，而直接平滑方法则存在过度平滑曲面及其边界的风险。我们提出了函数型注意力可解释回归（FAIR），该方法通过坐标特征直接表示 β(s,t)，并利用自注意力机制学习效应自适应的邻域，从而实现局部和全局尺度上的信息共享。一个标量压缩网络将这些学习到的表示映射到系数面上。在这些邻域上施加的稀疏性与平滑性惩罚促进了具有连贯边界的局部化支撑。我们建立了筛等价理论以...
tldr: 提出FAIR方法，通过坐标特征与自注意力机制直接学习函数对函数回归中系数面的复杂支撑结构，实现局部与全局尺度的自适应信息共享，并在稀疏与平滑约束下获得边界连贯的局部化估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes FAIR, which represents the coefficient surface directly via coordinate features and self-attention to learn effect-adaptive neighborhoods, enabling local and global information sharing with coherent localized support in function-on-function regression.
